author: shoop_raton
body:
Hola, Seuth here, and I was playing online earlier, and I thought, "Man, I think Avicus needs some new gamemodes", and after a little thinking, I thought we should add in a UHC type of game! If not everyone likes the real, Reddit or Badlion UHCs that take a while, we could add in a new UHC gamemode! I thought it could be like Nebula rotations (Like Mix01 etc), and there could be different types of UHC like speed, or there can be some games that are a legit Vanilla UHC. I personally am just writing this because I love UHC myself, and think it would be a great addition to the server.

pls r8 8/8 and dun h8 because i will cry in a corner becaus of how un nise u r :c

~Seuth
